AI-powered waste analytics: Greyparrot Analyzer computer-vision units monitor conveyor belts in sorting/recycling facilities to detect, identify and count packaging waste at brand/SKU level, giving Amcor real-world recyclability data. Greyparrot won Amcor's Lift-Off open-innovation challenge. [Greyparrot]
deployments_detail.value: 140+ Greyparrot Analyzer units active in 55 facilities; detected 40+ billion waste objects across 20+ countries in 2024

deployments_detail.use: Amcor (with Unilever and Asahi) is trialling Greyparrot's Deepnest AI waste-intelligence platform, which turns recycling-facility computer-vision data into brand-level packaging recyclability insights to inform more recyclable pack design. [Greyparrot (Deepnest)]

AI-powered computer-vision systems on production lines, fed by IoT sensors, trained to detect defects such as wrong sealing and damaged packaging and to flag machine anomalies, speeding up line-misalignment fixes and reducing waste.

Moda Bag on-demand bag maker/printer uses AI vision technology to scan each product on the line and dispense a custom-sized bag, reducing bag waste and cost. Showcased and demonstrated at IPPE trade shows.
deployments_detail.value: up to 30% reduction in bag waste and associated costs

deployments_detail.use: CleanStream recycling technology uses an automated pre-sorting process integrating optical sensor technologies, AI-based automated identification and machine-learning algorithms to produce contact-sensitive recycled polypropylene.

Demand and supply forecasting: Amcor trained the EazyML platform on three years of ERP history to optimize customer-demand and supply forecasts, capturing seasonal fluctuations and market correlations to better anticipate raw-material needs.
